name: ADIP Assistive Devices Support
officialName: Scheme of Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (ALIMCO / DEPwD)
detail: Free high-quality aids and appliances including motorized tricycles, smart canes, digital hearing aids, braille kits, and artificial limbs.
amount: 100% subsidy up to ₹15,000 (₹30,000 for motorized tricycles)

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension (NSAP)
officialName: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development & State Social Welfare Departments
detail: Direct monthly financial assistance paid into bank account for adults with severe/benchmark disabilities, with central and state contributions.
amount: ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month (varying by State top-up)

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
officialName: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Pre-Matric Scholarship
ministry: DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (NSP)
detail: Government scholarship covering monthly maintenance allowance, book grants, and disability allowances for Class 9 and 10 students.
amount: Up to ₹50,000 per year (₹1,000/mo maintenance + ₹1,000 book grant)

name: Post-Matric Disability Scholarship
officialName: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
ministry: DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (NSP)
detail: Financial assistance covering university tuition, maintenance allowances, reader allowances, and specialized study equipment for higher education.
amount: Up to ₹60,000 per year plus complete tuition reimbursement

name: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme
ministry: The National Trust for Welfare of Persons with Autism, CP, MR & MD
detail: Comprehensive health insurance cover across India for OPD consultations, diagnostic pathology, dental care, corrective surgeries, and continuous therapies.
amount: Cashless health cover up to ₹1,00,000 per year

name: Maharashtra UDID Facilitation Support
officialName: Maharashtra Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana & UDID Bridge
ministry: Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra
detail: State facilitation grant and monthly allowance for Unique Disability ID holders residing in Maharashtra for local welfare bridging.
amount: Monthly pension ₹1,500/month plus UDID facilitation up to ₹5,000

name: Goa Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS)
officialName: Dayanand Social Security Scheme for Persons with Disabilities (Goa)
ministry: Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa
detail: Dedicated monthly financial assistance for permanent residents of Goa holding disability certificates or UDID cards.
amount: ₹2,000 to ₹3,500 per month direct bank transfer

name: Accessible India Skill Training Stipend
officialName: National Action Plan for Skill Development of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
ministry: Skill Council for Persons with Disability (SCPwD) & MSDE
detail: Certified industry-aligned vocational training with monthly travel and boarding stipends, leading to wage employment and self-employment.
amount: ₹2,500 to ₹3,000 per month during training course

name: Senior Disability Care Assistance (Rashtriya Vayoshri)
officialName: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY) - Assisted Living Devices for Senior Citizens
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (ALIMCO)
detail: Physical assistive living devices and caregiver assistance for senior citizens with age-related disabilities or benchmark disabilities.
amount: Free assistive devices plus up to ₹2,500 per month care support

name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana (NHFDC)
officialName: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation Concessional Loan Scheme
ministry: NHFDC, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
detail: Concessional self-employment loans for starting small businesses, agricultural ventures, professional equipment, or education, with interest rebate for women.
amount: Concessional credit up to ₹50,00,000 at 5% to 8% interest p.a.
